ctor.rationale: `base(3, CardType.Power, CardRarity.Rare, TargetType.Self)` (Barricade.cs:15-18) == cost 3 / POWER / RARE / SELF. No keywords, no CanonicalVars (the power amount is the literal 1).

OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<BarricadePower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, 1m, Owner.Creature, this)` (Barricade.cs:23) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, BarricadePower, 1, applier=ctx.player)`. BarricadePower's ShouldClearBlock veto is already audited by the turn_structure seam (gaps G1/G2) and belongs to the power stream, not here. Presentation, folded in: Barricade.cs:22 runs CreatureCmd.TriggerAnim("PowerUp") first, and ExtraHoverTips (line 13) is a static Block hover tip. NOTE the card does NOT override GainsBlock, so `gains_block` correctly stays False in the sim and Nimble's CanEnchant refuses Barricade on both sides.

OnUpgrade.rationale: `EnergyCost.UpgradeBy(-1)` (Barricade.cs:28) == `self._energy_cost = max(0, self._energy_cost - 1)` (3 -> 2). Downgrade-safe; `card_probes.py downgrade` does not list barricade.
